role: tracked review metadata; no submission or hosted review implied

custom_fragments.decode: Concatenate each JSON source-line array, encode UTF-8, then concatenate all fragments in listed order.

head_binding: The static payload binds the declared product_source_epoch and exact file hashes. The metadata commit does not embed its own final SHA.

source_epoch_transition.unchanged_carrier_source_head_role: Historical source snapshot; unchanged payload identities are valid at the current product epoch.
source_epoch_transition.current_source_identity_authority: Current product_source_epoch and complete target mapping projection_after mode/blob values.
